## [0.3.1] - 2026-11-15
### Changed - Removed the setup guide reopen button from General settings; first-run setup still appears once. - Added spacing above the mouse reset wait description and styled it as secondary text.

## [0.3.0] - 2026-11-15
### Added - An optional first-run setup guide introduces the menu-bar app, Finder actions and their required access, launch at login, and automatic update checks, with an animated welcome, a separate permissions page before feature switches, grouped circular back and continue controls, an inline completion page with a celebration and an action to open the menu, and a reopen action in General settings.
### Changed - Closing setup preserves saved choices and prevents the guide from reopening automatically after restarts or upgrades; existing users see it once while keeping their settings. - New installations leave automatic update checks off until selected in setup or Settings, without a separate Sparkle permission prompt; existing update preferences and manual checks are preserved.
### Fixed - Setup errors stay attached to the window that initiated the action, including after controls refresh. - Finder configuration failures expose existing recovery or retry actions instead of an empty feature page. - Canceling quit restores a previously visible setup window at its current step.

## [0.2.3] - 2026-11-15
### Changed - Settings tabs now appear in General, Permissions, Mouse Reset, and About order.
### Fixed - Accessibility guidance now closes automatically when access is granted and stops checking when returning to Buckle or System Settings exits.
